# CreamTank

> B2B wholesale of food-grade N₂O (E942, UN1070) cream chargers. Pallet MOQ only. EU warehouse fulfilment (France, Germany, Spain) plus UK warehouse options for professional foodservice buyers.

## Products

- [Product range](https://creamtank.com/#products): Large-format food-grade cream chargers for B2B wholesale — CDL Sixth Wave 666g, Cream Deluxe 666g, CDL Black Cobra 666g (EU), FastGas ~670g (UK).
- [CDL Sixth Wave Edition 666](https://creamtank.com/#product-sixth-wave): Food-grade N₂O cream charger, 666g, EU warehouse network, pallet MOQ, 6 per carton.
- [Cream Deluxe 666g](https://creamtank.com/#product-cream-deluxe): E942 large-format cream charger for professional buyers; UN1070 Class 2.2 / 5.1 labelling on pack art.
- [CDL Black Cobra 666g](https://creamtank.com/#product-black-cobra): Food-grade cream charger line for B2B channels; 6 per carton; pallet wholesale.
- [FastGas ~670g](https://creamtank.com/#product-fastgas): Large-format cream charger with UK warehouse fulfilment; about 504 pcs per pallet; quote includes DG freight.

## Fulfillment

- [EU & UK warehouse fulfilment](https://creamtank.com/#fulfilment): EU network in France, Germany and Spain with stock ready and typical delivery within 7 days; UK warehouse for selected SKUs such as FastGas.
- [How buying works](https://creamtank.com/#buying): MOQ is 1 pallet only — no small retail parcels; company details and lawful food/industrial end use required; DG freight UN1070.

## FAQ

- [FAQ — food-grade N₂O cream chargers](https://creamtank.com/#faq): Buyer questions on E942 use, pallet MOQ, EU/UK fulfilment countries, lead times, who can buy, certificates status, and how to inquire.
- [Quality & documents](https://creamtank.com/#docs): Food-grade wholesale positioning; cylinder conformity under TPED (notified body 0036 / EN ISO 11118) on request for qualified B2B buyers; no blanket E942 COA claim — ask for current document list.
- [Compliance posture](https://creamtank.com/#compliance): Verified B2B foodservice, bakery, food-processing or industrial buyers only; recreational use declined.

## Key Facts

- Brand: CreamTank
- Industry: B2B food-grade N₂O (E942) cream charger wholesale
- MOQ: 1 pallet only (no loose retail / small-parcel fulfilment)
- EU warehouses: France, Germany, Spain — ship from the nearest warehouse to the delivery address; EU stock ready, typical delivery within 7 days
- UK warehouse: available for selected SKUs (e.g. FastGas ~670g)
- Hazard class: UN1070 · Class 2.2 with 5.1
- Audience: verified foodservice, bakery, food-processing and industrial buyers
- Certificates: TPED cylinder conformity (notified body 0036 / EN ISO 11118) available on request for qualified B2B buyers; E942 COA not claimed as standard public pack — ask for current document list
- No public list prices on the website
